content.text:
Needed: A small screen the board can drive (an I2C OLED or a 16x2 LCD) for Smart desk calendar and alarm
Kind of part: Any item
Top price: 50 USD

request.instructions: You plan a search of second-hand listings for one needed part or device. Write 3 to 6 search phrasings a seller might have put in a listing title: the plain name, synonyms, the part or model number in the ways it gets written, the devices it is sold for, seller wording and common misspellings; each with one line on what it finds that the others miss. A phrasing is a few words for a search box that takes words, not operators or quotes. Then one match pattern: an RE2 regular expression, applied case-insensitively to a listing's text, that a listing which fits the need matches, built from the part number with optional separators or the deciding values with their units. Keep it under 200 characters; use short gaps such as .{0,20} and classes such as [-\s]?; no lookarounds, no backreferences, no comments and no inline flags. Then the words or short phrases in a listing that rule it out: for parts, broken, not working, and any that name a variant that does not fit. Never invent a part or model number the need does not give.

content.text: {"exclusions": ["broken", "not working", "for parts only", "cracked screen", "20x4 LCD", "TFT display", "7 inch screen"], "pattern": "(0\\.96.{0,20}oled|oled.{0,20}0\\.96|16.{0,5}x.?2.{0,20}lcd|ssd1306|1602)", "phrasings": [{"text": "I2C OLED display 0.96 inch", "url": "https://www.ebay.com/sch/i.html?_nkw=I2C+OLED+display+0.96+inch", "why": "Finds the plain I2C OLED size most sellers list for Arduino projects."}, {"text": "SSD1306 OLED screen module", "url": "https://www.ebay.com/sch/i.html?_nkw=SSD1306+OLED+screen+module", "why": "Finds listings titled by driver chip instead of size or I2C."}, {"text": "1602 LCD I2C module", "url": "https://www.ebay.com/sch/i.html?_nkw=1602+LCD+I2C+module", "why": "Finds the 16x2 LCD with I2C backpack under its model number."}, {"text": "16x2 LCD display Arduino", "url": "https://www.ebay.com/sch/i.html?_nkw=16x2+LCD+display+Arduino", "why": "Finds 16x2 screens listed by size for Arduino without model number."}, {"text": "Arduino mini display screen", "url": "https://www.ebay.com/sch/i.html?_nkw=Arduino+mini+display+screen", "why": "Finds generic small-screen lots that do not name OLED or LCD type."}]}
